## Editorial and technical decision

- Selected one distinct source-backed search question: **Why can AgentSight report choose a different database or switch to agent-native history?** Distinct from native-session discovery (provider file indexing), no-eBPF capability (sensor boundary), and JSON export schema (fields after source selection).
- Source audit of exact v1.0.35 Rust: `report_db_or_local` chooses local, explicit DB, then latest `agentsight-*.db` in current directory; latest means filesystem mtime. Missing default DB yields a warning and import of at most 25 native histories. Explicit missing DB errors. Nested subcommand DB precedence is separately documented. `AGENTSIGHT_DB_PATH` applies to record/bind but is not read by the report dispatch. These are source findings, **not runtime reproductions or incident claims**.
- Proposed one coherent rendered outcome: `/blog/how-agentsight-report-selects-a-session/`, Blog index entry and sitemap entry, with source-linked decision and counterexample tables, commands, privacy limits and canonical ownership. Reader acceptance: article available at canonical URL with one H1/TechArticle; index and sitemap include it; unchanged homepage and latest prior article retain their behavior.
- Protected control plane, workflow, gitlink, raw analytics, credentials and schedules not modified. Rollback baseline: website `67aa102c4afbd4c8bf61f0c3f1528715b3a984d7`.
